study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter randomized controlled trial
cohort: 1,019 women randomized to azithromycin and 994 to placebo, all of whom underwent unscheduled cesarean delivery in labor with viable pregnancies.
finding: Diabetes, prolonged ruptured membranes, and postpartum fevers were significantly associated with increased risk of readmission or unexpected visits after unscheduled cesarean delivery, while azithromycin prophylaxis was protective.
mod_finding: The findings on risk factors for readmission or unexpected visits are specific to women who underwent unscheduled cesarean delivery.
